scope: original frozen V4 validation engineering cost for the two largest remaining fine cells, V6 detailed same-row timing

Cross-check selected count, membership sizes and tie counts against independent predictions and immutable scientific outputs.
measurement.timing: same-row verification plus append excluding commit and direct budget publication; separately retain raw verification, nested rank stages, append, direct budget, all commits, setup and tail
measurement.sources: seven frozen validation sources after selection seal; readonly immutable reconstruction and four-arm verification; compare every scientific frame and concatenated SHA in two fresh directories
